purpose: Set the quantity of one cart line (identified by sciItemId) and return the recalculated line and order totals as JSON including rendered cart HTML.

query.name: sciItemId
query.description: ShoppingCartItem id of the line, taken from the id/name itemquantity<id> on GET /cart or the data-href of the quantity input.

query.name: isCartPage
query.description: Sent by the UI on /cart; selects the cart-page rendering of the response.

query.name: newQuantity
query.description: Also accepted in the query string (model binding); the UI sends it in the body.

bodyFields.name: newQuantity
bodyFields.description: Integer quantity. 1..min(10000, stock) updates the line; 0 or negative removes the line; above 10000 or stock is rejected; non-numeric/empty/decimal/missing yields a 502 from the load balancer.

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true, SubTotal:'$9.50 excl tax', message:[], cartHtml:'<html of the cart rows>', displayCheckoutButtons:true, newItemPrice:'$1.90 excl tax'}; cartHtml contains the new line total and the order total; GET /cart then shows the new itemquantity<id> value.

failure.bodySignal: Over limit: 200 with JSON {success:false, message:['The maximum quantity allowed for purchase is 10000.'] or ['Your quantity exceeds stock on hand. The maximum quantity that can be added is 8563.'], SubTotal unchanged}; quantity unchanged. Quantity 0 / negative: line is removed but response is 500 {error:true, controller:'shoppingcart', action:'updatecartitem', message:'Object reference not set to an instance of an object.'}. Unknown sciItemId or an item owned by another visitor: 500 same body, nothing changed. Non-numeric/empty/2.5/missing newQuantity: 502 HTML 'Bad Gateway' (awselb/2.0). GET: 404.

purpose: Render the shopping cart page with line items, per-line totals, subtotal and order total (read-only here, used to observe the effect of updates).

success.bodySignal: HTML; one <input id="itemquantity<id>" value="<qty>" data-href="/shoppingcart/updatecartitem?sciItemId=<id>&isCartPage=True"> per line; text '$X excl tax' for unit price, line total and Subtotal; summary table with Subtotal/Shipping/Tax/Total.

failure.bodySignal: Empty cart renders the page without any itemquantity<id> inputs.

purpose: Setup only (owned by unit cart-add): add product 8 (Supreme Golfball, $1.90) quantity 1 to the cart so there is a line to update.
contentType: none (empty body, but Content-Length: 0 is required)

failure.bodySignal: HTTP 411 Length Required (HTML, Microsoft-HTTPAPI/2.0) when POST is sent without Content-Length; curl needs -d '' or -H 'Content-Length: 0'.
